newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Aug CPI up 3.5 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Aug CPI up 3.5 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Malaysia's Consumer Price Index (CPI) for August rose 3.5 percent from the same month a year ago, the national Bernama news agency said on Saturday.
Quoting a report from the Statistics Department, Bernama said the CPI last month was unchanged from July 1996.
In July 1996, the index grew by 3.6 percent.
The index also rose 3.6 percent for the first eight months of the year, the same as the corresponding period of last year.
The CPI's growth for August was due to price increases in almost all goods and services, except clothing and footwear, said the statistics department.
Food, gross rent, fuel and power accounted for 75.1 percent of the overall increase.
